data.translation:
The mastermind behind the case of the rape of a teenage girl in Sampang Regency, Madura, by 27 men has been uncovered. He is a man with the initials AP (15).

"It's true (the mastermind of the rape action with initials AP)," said the Head of Public Relations of the Sampang Police Resort, AKP Eko Puji Waluyo, to kumparan, Wednesday (15/7).

Eko explained that the victim and AP had known each other previously. At one point in February 2026, the victim met AP and the other suspects' friends.

The victim was then invited to join and taken for a ride, pillion on a motorcycle. It turned out that AP and his friends had malicious intentions. He took the victim to a patch of bushes in Panggung Village, Sampang District/Regency, and carried out his depraved act along with the other suspects.

Eko said that investigators have completed the case file or P21 for 8 suspects. Currently, police have arrested 13 suspects out of the 27 people suspected of being involved in the rape.

The suspects are charged under Article 473 paragraph (2) of Law Number 1 of 2023 concerning the Criminal Code, provisions of legislation regarding the Juvenile Justice System, as well as Article 82 paragraph (1) and paragraph (2) of Law Number 23 of 2002 concerning Child Protection, with a maximum penalty of 15 years in prison.

result.text:
Otak di balik kasus pemerkosaan remaja putri di Kabupaten Sampang, Madura, oleh 27 orang pria terungkap. Ia adalah pria berinisial AP (15).

"Betul (otak aksi pemerkosaan berinisial AP)," kata Kasi Humas Polres Sampang, AKP Eko Puji Waluyo kepada kumparan, Rabu (15/7).

Eko menyampaikan bahwa korban dan AP sebelumnya saling mengenal. Suatu ketika pada bulan Februari 2026, korban bertemu dengan AP dan teman-teman tersangka.

Korban kemudian diajak bergabung dan berkeliling dibonceng menggunakan sepeda motor. Rupanya, AP dan teman-temannya memiliki niat busuk. Ia membawa korban ke sebuah semak-semak di Desa Panggung, Kecamatan/Kabupaten Sampang, dan melancarkan aksi bejatnya bersama tersangka lainnya.

Eko mengatakan bahwa penyidik telah melengkapi berkas perkara atau P21 terhadap 8 tersangka. Saat ini, polisi telah menangkap 13 tersangka dari 27 orang yang diduga terlibat pemerkosaan.

Para tersangka dijerat dengan Pasal 473 ayat (2) Undang-Undang Nomor 1 Tahun 2023 tentang KUHP, ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan mengenai Sistem Peradilan Pidana Anak, serta Pasal 82 ayat (1) dan ayat (2) Undang-Undang Nomor 23 Tahun 2002 tentang Perlindungan Anak, dengan ancaman pidana maksimal 15 tahun penjara.
